newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Ares-Serono, Fournier set hormone accord.
newsitem.headline: Ares-Serono, Fournier set hormone accord.

text.p: Ares-Serono Group said it concluded a licensing agreement with Groupe Fournier to co-develop and market in the United States a series of five transdermal hormone replacement products.

It said in a statement it expected the launch of the entire series to take place between 1998 and 2001. The products include two oestrogen therapies, two that combine oestrogen and progestin, and one progestin product.
U.S. affiliate Serono Laboratories Inc will market the products, which will be manufactured by privately held Fournier's Tilderm Systems.
